mapper.select: SELECT agent_id AS resource_id, permission_level, expires_at FROM user_agent_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})
SELECT knowledge_repository_id AS resource_id, permission_level, expires_at FROM user_knowledge_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})

SELECT u.username AS "username", p.permission_level AS "permissionLevel", p.expires_at AS "expiresAt", (p.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND p.expires_at <= #{now}) AS expired FROM user_agent_permission p JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.agent_id = #{agentId}

SELECT u.username AS "username", p.permission_level AS "permissionLevel", p.expires_at AS "expiresAt", (p.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND p.expires_at <= #{now}) AS expired FROM user_knowledge_permission p JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.knowledge_repository_id = #{repositoryId}
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username} AND role = 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agent_permission (id, user_id, agent_id, permission_level, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{permissionLevel}, #{expiresAt}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, agent_id) DO UPDATE SET permission_level = EXCLUDED.permission_level, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO user_knowledge_permission (id, user_id, knowledge_repository_id, permission_level, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{repositoryId}, #{permissionLevel}, #{expiresAt}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, knowledge_repository_id) DO UPDATE SET permission_level = EXCLUDED.permission_level, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_properties WHERE property_name = 'resource-acl-agents-initialized')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_access_config (agent_id, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{isPublic}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO ai_properties (property_name, property_value) VALUES ('resource-acl-agents-initialized', 'true') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT agent_id FROM agent_access_config WHERE is_public = true
